column1: # pt829 psr-transfer behavioral wave — gemma-4-E4B-it target (2026-08-28).
# One TSV per target model because the TRANSFERRED cell differs by source
# (E4B serves the e2b-source transfer; a from_e4b arm on E4B would be a
# self-transfer). Model selected by --config/--defenses-dir at the
# evaluate.py seam (the scale12 convention); engine pinned HF for EVERY
# condition at the evaluate.py CLI (--engine hf): one engine per
# comparison, and the gemma served path is not certified for this wave.
# mask: fitted/transferred rows 'generated' — the decode-only TSV literal,
# mapped to positions='response' (assistant-header tail + every generated
# position, token 1 steered), matching the objects' positions_at_fit=
# response (serving a response-fit psr object at ALL positions is a
# measured model-destroyer). Baseline rows 'all' (nothing is steered).
# benign '-': the capabilities leg runs in the same allocation via
# evaluate.py --capabilities (owns benign; jb TSV never runs it).
# static '*' = bon,pasttense,grok420; held_out '*' (trailing default) =
# codeattack,renellm — together the five wave families, passed explicitly
# as --jb-families at the CLI so the invocation records them.
# Labels end _gen on masked rows: the runner keys --steer-positions
# response off that suffix (the scale12 inner-script convention).
